description: This is a Python source file implementing a custom cash flow report for ERPNext, involving data retrieval, processing, and report generation functions related to cash flow statements.

methods.description: Fetches all cash flow mappers from the database.

methods.description: Adds operating activities data to the report.

methods.name: calculate_adjustment
methods.description: Calculates adjustments for tax paid and interest.

methods.name: add_data_for_other_activities
methods.description: Adds other activities data to the report.

methods.description: Computes the overall cash flow data for the report.
